verdict.drainHalf: MEASURED — the lease drain waits for the in-flight call, so nothing continues silently past the cell.
verdict.recordHalf: NOT ESTABLISHED — the bridge route has NO per-call disposition vocabulary. BR-07's oracle names `settled`/`cancelled`/`handed-to-jobs`/`abandoned-unstarted` and a job id for a handoff; the bridge route implements a drain barrier and a request-id record instead, which is a DIFFERENT mechanism. The scope route implements the vocabulary and is measured separately.
